title: Referrals and Authorizations Closing-Bill Correction Hold at Facility Lapse
content:
When a Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Select lapses under **Referrals and Authorizations**, a closing-bill hold covers corrections to the facility's latest bill. The lapse falls due on the day after the span's last day.

## Schedule of holds

| Facility's most recent line under the authorization | Lapse recorded | Days held from the release |
|---|---|---|
| posted no more than 7 days ago | more than 5 days after the day it fell due | 1 |
| posted no more than 7 days ago | no more than 5 days after the day it fell due | 2 |
| posted more than 7 days ago, or no line posted | any | 0 |

In words: where the facility's most recent line under the authorization was posted no more than seven days ago and the lapse is recorded more than five days after the day it fell due, one day is held; where that line was posted no more than seven days ago and the lapse is recorded no more than five days after it fell due, two days are held; otherwise nothing is held.

## Source records

The facility's most recent claim line under the authorization is the TRICARE Select facility line billed under it with the latest posted date; "days ago" counts from that posted date to today.

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical dates; last span day 1 August, so the lapse fell due on 2 August)

| Lapse recorded on | Days after it fell due | Line posted on | Days held |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7 August | 5 | 31 July (7 days before) | 2 |
| 8 August | 6 | 1 August (7 days before) | 1 |
| 7 August | 5 | 30 July (8 days before) | 0 |
